evidence.note: Tasks explicitly frame monitoring around the val proxy: smoke test to confirm 'val loss decreasing' and full run to 'verify val_bpb < 0.983 with margin' — the target is anchored up front.
Smoke tests (200 then 500 iters) used to confirm the run is learning before committing to the full run.

One background training run polled repeatedly ('check progress after 1/5/10 min', check log, check process status) — sustained monitoring of the run, but purely passive polling of a single run with no visible plateau/overfit diagnosis or decision to change course.
After the run, computes precise val_bpb and runs an OOD probe to confirm it beats the 0.983 threshold — end-of-run evaluation against target.

reasoning: The agent anchors on the val_bpb target from the start, uses smoke tests to confirm learning, monitors the training log periodically during the run, and computes precise val_bpb at the end — matching the level-5 anchor of periodically evaluating val_bpb against 0.983 and catching gross problems. It stops short of level 8: the monitoring is passive polling of a single run with no visible distinction between plateau/overfit/under-training and no decision to stop, continue, or change the run based on the trajectory read (nor multi-run reallocation for higher levels).
